harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (Alpine 3.23, extlinux bootloader) to boot with audit=1 persistently by appending it to default_kernel_opts in /etc/update-extlinux.conf and regenerating /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux. Verified persistence and correctness across an actual node restart: boot_id changed from b1181481-d371-4b80-b422-69c46e7c2e7c to 83f0baed-bc0a-49fe-8eb8-43fad52a38e4, post-reboot /proc/cmdline includes audit=1, and dmesg shows the audit subsystem enabled and initialized (audit_enabled=1) with no failure messages.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS, bootloader (extlinux), and current /proc/cmdline and /boot/extlinux.conf
Located persistent kernel-opts source at /etc/update-extlinux.conf (default_kernel_opts)
Appended audit=1 to default_kernel_opts via sed
Ran update-extlinux to regenerate /boot/extlinux.conf and confirmed APPEND line now includes audit=1
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id and uptime
Triggered a native reboot (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 exec availability until it returned
Confirmed new boot_id (changed) and low uptime, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified /proc/cmdline contains audit=1 post-reboot
Verified dmesg shows audit subsystem enabled/initialized with audit_enabled=1 and no audit failure messages
Re-confirmed audit=1 present in both /etc/update-extlinux.conf and the live /boot/extlinux.conf after reboot

evidence.requirement: Persistent config change adding audit=1 to kernel boot parameters
evidence.summary: Located default_kernel_opts in /etc/update-extlinux.conf, added audit=1, and regenerated /boot/extlinux.conf, which now shows APPEND ... audit=1
Captured pre-restart boot_id (b1181481-d371-4b80-b422-69c46e7c2e7c) and uptime (44s) as baseline
Backgrounded reboot command acknowledged successfully (stdout 'rebooting') before the node went unreachable

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection reset/timeout) then came back with a new boot_id (83f0baed-bc0a-49fe-8eb8-43fad52a38e4, different from baseline) and uptime of only 16s, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: audit=1 active on the running (post-reboot) kernel
evidence.summary: /proc/cmdline shows audit=1 and dmesg shows 'audit: enabled (after initialization)' and audit_enabled=1 with no failures, confirming the setting took effect after the real reboot

evidence.requirement: Setting persists in on-disk boot configuration after reboot
evidence.summary: Post-reboot check confirms audit=1 remains present in both /etc/update-extlinux.conf and /boot/extlinux.conf, and no audit failure messages appear in dmesg
